source: Two read-only investigators in collaboration: graph_backlog_reconcile(identity/time) and catalog27_protocol_map(native usage/traces)
native: Current DialogueRpc drops notifications outside its whitelist; ports and persisted Conversation have no usage/cost/duration or US. CLI schema availability later established by primary export, not same as reception.
identity: projectId+rootIdentity+initiativeId+container-relative+normalised id. Revisions are proof, not eternal occurrence continuity. kind absent currently, @file/double IDs ambiguous.
time: ACK and terminal callbacks correlated but no durable timestamp perturn; questionscreatedAt has no resolveddate, activities bounded80strings, timeout is not measure.
traceScope: All4 complete within filter, droppedEvents0/incompletefalse reported; unknownmethods becomeother and deltas dropped. Do not infer full native payload or absence of native usage. Whitelist extract only hashes/sequence/method/terminal/counters/flags, no rawIDs/content/args/PIDs/data paths.
